snippet.title: Slow Roads 2.0 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play now at https://slowroads.io and wishlist on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3431300/Slow_Roads/

Slow Roads is a casual, browser-based driving game all about finding peace in a long, scenic journey. Version 1.0 was released in 2022, but its prototype engine wasn't robust enough for long-term development. So, after many months of work, it's been rebuilt from the ground up to be more stable, easier to develop, and much prettier. Now with 3D trees, improved lighting effects, upgraded shaders, and mobile support - this video gives a quick peek at what's new.

The Slow Roads engine is unique in that the worlds and roads are generated organically, so that it is truly expansive and no two corners are alike. It's developed by me, alone, as a hobby project, and hosted for free online on slowroads.io. Over the years I've had a lot of requests for extra features - more than I could add in my spare time - so I'm bringing those features to Steam as a way to fund further development. Please support me by wishlisting the game and following along!
